state.feedback:
Design an offline-first notes app syncing across devices.

She started with the conflict question: what happens when two devices edit the same note offline? Proposed per-note operation logs with CRDT text merging for body content and last-writer-wins for metadata like title/tags, explaining why she'd accept LWW there. Sync protocol: device keeps a vector clock/cursor, pulls deltas since cursor, pushes local ops in batches with idempotent op IDs. Storage: SQLite locally with an outbox table. Attachments uploaded separately with content hashes to dedupe.

I pushed on 'user deletes a note on one device while editing on another': she proposed tombstones with a resurrect-on-edit rule and a user-visible 'restored' banner, which is exactly what we ended up shipping.

Also considered battery (sync on network change + backoff, not a timer).

why: Deep, concrete sync design incl. edge cases
